<DOCSTRING>
Manages a collection of users and processes them.

This class is responsible for maintaining a list of users and processing each user to determine if they are an adult or a minor. It is used by the system to handle user data and ensure that user statuses are correctly logged.

@attribute {Array<Object>} users - The list of users managed by this class. Each user is an object with properties like `name` and `isAdult`.

@method {void} addUser(user) - Adds a user to the system and processes them.
- @param {Object} user - The user object to add. Must have a `name` property and an `isAdult` method that returns a boolean.

@method {void} process(user) - Logs whether a user is an adult or a minor based on their age.
- @param {any} user - Input value. Must have a `name` property and an `isAdult` method that returns a boolean.
- @returns {void} No value is returned. The function logs the user's status to the console.
- @throws {Error} This function does not throw any errors.
</DOCSTRING>
